title: Enable `CodeExecutorAgent` to generate its own code and executing it.
body:
### Confirmation

- [x] I confirm that I am a maintainer and so can use this template. If I am not, I understand this issue will be closed and I will be asked to use a different template.

### Issue body

Adding optional parameters: `system_message` and `model_client` to `CodeExecutorAgent` so it can generate and execute its own code -- achieving similar behavior as OpenAI Assistant Agent with code interpreter.

linked_prs.title: Add code generation support to `CodeExecutorAgent`
linked_prs.body:

- To add support for code generation, execution and reflection to `CodeExecutorAgent`.
